caption: The model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) as a function of the Activated Parameters Ratio under several sparsity configurations applied to Transformer components. The x-axis is labeled “Activated Parameters Ratio(%)”, uses a linear scale, and shows values decreasing from 100 to 25 with labeled ticks at 100, 75, 50, and 25 (25-point intervals). The y-axis is labeled “Eval PPL.”, uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from about 11.0 up to slightly above 14.0 with labeled ticks at 11.5, 12.0, 12.5, 13.0, 13.5, and 14.0 (0.5 intervals). A red dashed horizontal line labeled “Transformer” remains constant across all x values at approximately 11.6. The “Only MoHD FFN” series is a solid gray line with square markers, staying near about 11.45 at 100 and 75, dipping to around 11.3 at 50, then rising to about 11.8 at 25. The “Only MoHD ATTN” series is a solid dark-blue line with circular markers, starting near about 11.4 at 100, slightly increasing to about 11.55 at 75, rising to around 12.25 at 50, and reaching roughly 14.3 at 25. The “MoHD ATTN + MLP” series is a solid light-blue line with x-shaped markers, beginning around 11.45 at 100, remaining near about 11.5 at 75, increasing to about 12.05 at 50, and ending near about 13.2 at 25.
